billet.titre:
Your ticket,
your name, your seat.
billet.texte: One departure, one seat, one payment: your ticket arrives by SMS with a QR code and a 4-digit code. At the platform, you are scanned and you board.
billet.detail: one departure, one seat, one payment

colis.titre: Your parcel tracked all the way
colis.texte: You drop off your parcel, we take a photo of it, then the recipient gets a pick-up code. You follow every step until delivery.

proches.titre: Your relatives know when you arrive
proches.texte: A relative follows your bus live on the map, and gets an automatic SMS when you arrive.
